description: Land Acquisition - Telangapatha, Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. Notice No. 1894/20 of 26.12.2014 by Thihagoda D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes a specific land parcel (Lot No. 01, Galabadawatta) with detailed location information, extent (0.0092 Hectare), and purpose (public purpose). The notice serves to inform interested parties about the acquisition and compensation claims process, which falls squarely under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
